notes.title: Development update!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p]I’d like to share some news about the development of the game.[/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for your continued support—and I owe you a big apology for the delay. Development was on hold for three years due to my health issues and financial difficulties. However, I'm happy to say that development resumed in February 2025.[/p][p]I also now have a distributor for the game: [b]Render System[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s New?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Upgraded Track Graphics[/b]
A major visual upgrade! All tracks are being redesigned from the ground up for improved gameplay and a fresh look.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/e5c69f58882f5232b7e1d5d417b9d488c419122c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Day/Night/Overcast Options[/b] Race in different conditions—midday, night, or overcast—for a more immersive experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/799dfbac22bc61ad765d27d958add2529b570779.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/320f6805dd4a9121a956f905cdc12a3abb259dc0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Normal and Reverse Racing Modes[/b]
Every track now supports both standard and reverse racing.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improved Physics[/b]
Enhanced realism with physically-based objects like pallets and tires around the tracks.[/p][p]Please note: the game is still arcade-style, not a simulation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/519ab6070632b35c4d282898ce340990b8bcacd7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]More Fun Gameplay Elements[/b]
Experience more dynamic racing with jumps and the ability to bump into opponents or obstacles on the track.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/fb8e0e2ba9a713e2ee8ed82a8e093d55540bf416.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Split-Screen Support[/b]
Local multiplayer is back! Play with friends on the same screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/63f634234696aafa1ad02f5fdf22319470bc2769.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779480/530f7d9bfdd70052defa05385e4d069eacff8a85.png"][/img][/p][p][b]AI:[/b][/p][p]The AI is improved, with multiple difficulty settings available[/p]
